lines.en: But not without a very special guest...
lines.zh: : 不过,还跟着一位非常特别的嘉宾……

lines.en: : I’m bored.
lines.zh: : 我好无聊。

lines.en: : Well, you had the opportunity to leave when that convoy of limos showed up, but you decided to follow me here instead. So you did this to yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那队豪华轿车出现的时候,你有机会走的,是你决定跟着我来这里。所以这是自作自受。

lines.en: : Tsukasa Tsukioka deserves more than just a convoy of limos. If Mother thinks she can buy me off with just that, she is sorely mistaken.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa Tsukioka 值得的不只是一队轿车。要是妈妈以为光靠那个就能打发我,那她就大错特错了。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine buying you off at all is feasible considering how numb you already are to money at your age but, to satisfy my own curiosity, what will it take for you to leave?
lines.zh: : 我无法想象「收买你」这件事可行——毕竟你这个年纪,对钱已经麻木了。但为了满足我自己的好奇心:要怎样才能让你走?

lines.en: : I’m making Mother come here to get me on her own. It isn’t fair that I should have to be surrounded by lowly peons on my own national holiday.
lines.zh: : 我要让妈妈亲自来接我。在我自己的全国节日里,还要被一群低贱的喽啰包围,这不公平。

lines.en: : I thought your mother was busy?
lines.zh: : 我记得你妈妈很忙?

lines.en: : She won’t be if I ask enough. That’s just how important I am.
lines.zh: : 只要我开口够多,她就不忙。我就是这么重要。

lines.en: In just seven hours, I have gone from the world’s most sexually active teacher to the world’s most exhausted teacher.
lines.zh: : 仅仅七个小时,我就从「全世界性生活最活跃的老师」,变成了「全世界最疲惫的老师」。

lines.en: Well, after Wakana- who I’m consistently shocked to see roaming the halls despite looking like she is going to drop dead at any moment.
lines.zh: : 嗯,排在 Wakana 之后——虽然她看着随时会当场倒毙,却一直在大厅里游荡,这让我持续震惊。

lines.en: Regardless, I must now play babysitter while waiting for someone to come take this brat off of my hands.
lines.zh: : 无论如何,我现在必须当保姆,等某个人来把这个小鬼接走。

lines.en: I guess you can call it practice for when I have to visit Chika’s house and watch both her and Chinami soon, but at least then I’ll have Chinami to keep her occupied. And Touka to keep me occupied.
lines.zh: : 你可以把它当成「不久后要去 Chika 家、同时看住她和 Chinami」的预演。但至少到那时,有 Chinami 陪她玩,还有 Touka 陪我玩。

lines.en: : Jeeves, tell me a story.
lines.zh: : Jeeves,给我讲个故事。

lines.en: : No.
: But it’s-
lines.zh: : 可是今天——

lines.en: : I know what day it is. But I will not be bossed around in my own office by someone I could pick up with one hand.
lines.zh: : 我知道今天是什么日子。但我不会在自己办公室里,被一个我单手就能拎起来的人呼来喝去。

lines.en: : If you’re not going to tell me a story, can you at least do something to keep me entertained?
lines.zh: : 那你不讲故事,至少能干点别的让我开心吗?

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么?

lines.en: : How am I supposed to know? You’re the adult here. Aren’t you supposed to be full of guidance and wisdom?
lines.zh: : 我怎么会知道?这里的大人是「你」。你不是应该满肚子指引和智慧吗?

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re old enough for my guidance and wisdom yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你还没到能接受我的指引和智慧的年纪。

lines.en: : What about that game you were playing with the peasant girl at the onsen?
lines.zh: : 那你在温泉和平民女孩玩的那个游戏呢?

lines.en: : I really hope your mom gets here within the next thirty seconds because that is a road that even I am not ready to traverse just yet.
lines.zh: : 我衷心希望你妈妈在三十秒内赶到,因为那条路,连我眼下都还没准备好走。

lines.en: : Hah...Of course it’s not. This Tsukasa Day sucks. It’s like nobody is appreciating me any more than they normally do.
lines.zh: : 哈……当然不是。这个月司日太烂了。就好像没有人比平时更喜欢我一分。

lines.en: : The only difference is I got to go to high school. And even that wasn’t very fun.
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是我去了趟高中。而那也不怎么好玩。

lines.en: : I’m not sure what you were expecting, but school isn’t really known for being “fun.”
lines.zh: : 我不知道你期待什么,但学校向来不以「好玩」著称。

lines.en: : Not like I would know. I’m not allowed to go to school.
lines.zh: : 那我可不知道。我又「不被允许」上学。

lines.en: : Not allowed? Or just not willing to settle for a commoner school?
lines.zh: : 不被允许?还是不愿意屈就平民学校?

lines.en: : I would settle for a commoner school if I had to.
lines.zh: : 真要的话,我可以屈就平民学校。

lines.en: : I’m the second in line to inherit the Tsukioka family business, so it’s not like I have to get the highest form of education when my older sister is going to be the one to take over.
lines.zh: : 我是月冈家业的第二顺位继承人,所以既然将来接管家业的是我姐姐,我不必接受最高等的教育。

lines.en: : Unless staying here makes her brain turn into mush. Which, based on what I have seen here today, it might.
lines.zh: : 除非待在这里会把她的脑子泡成浆糊。而根据我今天在这里的所见,说不定会。

lines.en: : While what you say may be true, I’m not really sure what that has to do with you not being allowed to go to school.
lines.zh: : 虽然你说的可能是真的,但我不太确定这和「你不被允许上学」有什么关系。

lines.en: : Mother says I’m too “advanced” to go to school with girls my age and too young to go to school with Big Sister.
lines.zh: : 妈妈说,我太「超前」,不能和同龄的女孩一起上学;又太年幼,不能和姐姐一起上。

lines.en: : So all I can do is sit at home and listen to boring old people talk about boring stuff when what I really want to do is have fun.
lines.zh: : 所以我能做的只有坐在家里,听无聊的老人聊无聊的东西——而我真正想做的事是玩。

lines.en: : I’ve been to your house. I have a hard time believing there isn’t anything fun to do there.
lines.zh: : 我去过你家。我很难相信那里会没有好玩的事。

lines.en: : Nothing’s really fun if you do it every day. Which is why I like going out and seeing other stuff that I’m not able to see at home. Like tacos. Or “the subway.”
lines.zh: : 什么事天天做都会不好玩。所以我才喜欢出门,看看在家里看不到的东西。比如卷饼。或者「地铁」。

lines.en: : Or that very pale girl with the freckles who kept talking about demons.
lines.zh: : 还有那个满脸雀斑、皮肤苍白得吓人、一直讲恶魔的女孩。

lines.en: : That’s Molly and she isn’t really a tourist destination.
lines.zh: : 那是 Molly,而且她不算旅游景点。

lines.en: : In fact, none of the things you listed are tourist destinations and you should probably do a little more research if you really want to see the outside world.
lines.zh: : 事实上,你列的这些没有一个是旅游景点。你要是真想看看外面的世界,大概应该多做点功课。

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Or maybe you can officially accept the job as the new Jeeves Tsukioka the Thirteenth and we can go on all sorts of commoner adventures that-
lines.zh: : 又或者,你可以正式接受这份工作——成为新一任「Jeeves 月冈十三世」——然后我们就可以踏上各种平民冒险,那样——

lines.en: : No.
: You are being very rude to me, Jeeves. This sort of behavior will not be tolerated.
lines.zh: : 你对我非常无礼,Jeeves。这种行为不可容忍。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: : Ah! I’m telling Mother that you cursed at me!
lines.zh: : 啊!我要告诉妈妈你骂我!

lines.en: : Do it. I’m pretty sure she’ll understand.
lines.zh: : 去告啊。我相当确定她会理解。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh! Cursing at a child is something adults should never do! I’ve gotten at least ten other Jeeves fired because of that.
lines.zh: : 不————行!骂小孩是大人的禁区!因为这个,我已经搞掉了至少十个 Jeeves。

lines.en: : If ten other Jeeves cursed at you, don’t you think the problem might be...I don’t know, you?
lines.zh: : 要是十个 Jeeves 都骂过你,你不觉得问题可能出在……我不知道,你身上吗?

lines.en: : Tsukasa Tsukioka isn’t a problem. She is gifted and talented and richer than you and everyone else you know combined.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa Tsukioka 不是问题。她天赋异禀、才华横溢,比你和所有你认识的人加起来都有钱。

lines.en: : I know your sister, you know. And, unless she is a pathological liar who is only attending this school because she was excommunicated from your family, I’m pretty sure she’s rich too.
lines.zh: : 我认识你姐姐,你知道吗。而且,除非她是个病理性骗子、来这所学校只是因为她被逐出了家族,我相当确定她也有钱。

lines.en: : She might as well be excommunicated with how often she talks about her new fun and exciting commoner life.
lines.zh: : 照她炫耀新发现的、有趣刺激的平民生活的频率,她跟被逐出家族也没什么两样。

lines.en: : It’s like she doesn’t even remember we’re better than you or something.
lines.zh: : 就好像她根本不记得我们比你们高贵似的。

lines.en: : Or...she’s just starting to realize you’re not?
lines.zh: : 又或者……她只是刚开始意识到,你们「不」?

lines.en: : But we are.
lines.zh: : 可我们就是高贵。

lines.en: : How?
lines.zh: : 哪里高贵?

lines.en: : We’re smarter and cleaner and more sophisticated and cleaner and are trained in a variety of different skillsets that people like you aren’t exposed to. And also, we are cleaner.
lines.zh: : 我们更聪明、更干净、更精致、更干净,而且受过各种你们这种人接触不到的技能训练。还有,我们更干净。

lines.en: : I don’t know where this strange fascination with our personal hygiene comes from, but there are plenty of people out here who are just as talented as you and Touka.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们这种对个人卫生的奇怪执念从哪来的,但外面有一大堆人,和你们、Touka 一样有才华。

lines.en: : Like Tsuneyo. She was a national kendo champion and now she is a...noodle warrior.
lines.zh: : 比如 Tsuneyo。她当过全国剑道冠军,现在是个……面条武士。

lines.en: : A...noodle warrior?
lines.zh: : 一名……面条武士?

lines.en: : And then there’s Otoha who’s, like...some singing prodigy or something. And Nodoka, who is also prodigious in a lot of ways when she isn’t ruining the lives of ex-Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 还有 Otoha,她是……什么歌唱天才之类的。还有 Nodoka——在她不毁掉前极道人生的时候,她也有各种天赋。

lines.en: : What about the one girl with the ponytail who kept glaring at you all day? What’s she really good at?
lines.zh: : 那个扎马尾、一整天瞪着你的女孩呢?她擅长什么?

lines.en: : Uhh...
: She’s good at...
lines.zh: : 她擅长……

lines.en: : Eating?
lines.zh: : 吃东西?

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound very impressive to me, Jeeves. If you were trying to make me realize how interesting you people can be, you should have stopped at the Yakuza part.
lines.zh: : 这听起来一点也不厉害,Jeeves。如果你是想让我意识到你们这些人多有趣,你该停在极道那一段。

lines.en: : The fact of the matter is that there’s just a lot more to what makes a person good than how talented they are or...how “clean” they are.
lines.zh: : 事实是,决定一个人优点的,除了才华,或者……「干净」,还有很多别的。

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么?

lines.en: : Like how...nice they are. How open to change they are. How adaptable and versatile they can be in all types of situations.
lines.zh: : 比如他们……有多善良。有多愿意改变。在各种处境下,有多随机应变、多才多艺。

lines.en: : And who out of all of your students do you think is the best at all of those things?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得,你的学生里,谁在这些方面最出色?

lines.en: : Touka.
lines.zh: : Touka。

lines.en: : See, Jeeves? The Tsukioka family is just flat out better than everybody you know.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧,Jeeves?月冈家族就是比你们认识的任何人都强。

lines.en: : Some members at least. Others...I’m not convinced yet. But sure, you win this round, Tsurumi.
lines.zh: : 「某些成员」至少是。其他人……我还没被说服。但行,这局你赢了,Tsurumi。

lines.en: : Of course I win! A Tsukioka does not pick losing battles. Not that there are many battles we’d lose in the first place, but still.
lines.zh: : 我当然赢!月冈家的人从不打会输的架。倒不是说我们有几场架会输,但道理如此。

lines.en: : You are easily the most prideful person I have ever met and you probably can’t even ride a bike yet.
lines.zh: : 你 easily 是我见过最自负的人,而你多半连自行车都不会骑。

lines.en: : I don’t own a bike, but Big Sister lets me ride Morning Glory sometimes and I haven’t fallen off yet.
lines.zh: : 我没有自行车,但姐姐有时候会让我骑她的 Morning Glory,我到现在还没摔下来过。

lines.en: : Look at you, not even owning your own horse yet. And you call me a commoner.
lines.zh: : 瞧瞧你,连自己的马都没有。还管我叫平民。

lines.en: : I own seven horses. They’re just all display pets.
lines.zh: : 我有七匹马。只是全都是展示用的宠物。

lines.en: : What good is a display horse?
lines.zh: : 展示用的马有什么用?

lines.en: : You’d know if you could afford one. But sadly, unless you accept my proposition and become a real Jeeves, you never will.
lines.zh: : 你买得起就知道了。可惜,除非你接受我的提议、成为一名真正的 Jeeves,你永远体会不到。

lines.en: : How did you get like this when both of the other Tsukioka women are so approachable and kind?
lines.zh: : 月冈家的另外两位女性都这么平易近人、这么善良,你是怎么变成这样的?

lines.en: : Some people are just born with the gift, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是天赋异禀吧。

lines.en: : Is it too late to return it?
lines.zh: : 现在退货还来得及吗?

lines.en: : When you’re as rich as Tsukasarumi Tsukioka, you don’t have to return anything. You can just buy something else.
lines.zh: : 像月司路美月冈这么有钱的人,不需要退货。直接再买一个就行。

lines.en: : On second thought, I’m just going to blame your father as I can’t imagine Tsubasa or Touka having this sort of influence on you.
lines.zh: : 再想想,我还是怪你爸爸好了——我无法想象 Tsubasa 或 Touka 会对你施加这种影响。

lines.en: : It’s not Papa’s fault I’m like this. It’s probably just a side effect of being the second born in a family that typically only produces one heir.
lines.zh: : 我变成这样不是爸爸的错。这大概只是一个「通常只产一位继承人的家族」里,老二的副作用。

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t see him that much anyway. He’s always doing stuff and never has time for me anymore.
lines.zh: : 再说了,我也见不到他几次。他永远在忙,再也不为我腾出时间。

lines.en: : Really? With how much you talk about him, I figured you bothered- err...I figured you were with him all the time.
lines.zh: : 真的吗?听你聊他聊得那么多,我还以为你缠——呃……我还以为你们一直在一起。

lines.en: : Not really. I try to talk to him as much as I can, but I think he forgets to charge his walkie talkie sometimes.
lines.zh: : 并没有。我尽量多和他说话,但我觉得他有时候忘了给他的对讲机充电。

lines.en: : Walkie talkie?
lines.zh: : 对讲机?

lines.en: : Mhm. Santa brought me a walkie talkie a few years ago so I could talk to Papa whenever I wanted.
lines.zh: : 嗯。几年前圣诞老人送了我一台对讲机,这样我想找爸爸的时候就能说话。

lines.en: : Does he not have a cell phone?
lines.zh: : 他没有手机吗?

lines.en: : He does. But he says that it’s for work only and that I’m not allowed to call him on it during the day.
lines.zh: : 有。但他说手机只用于工作,白天不许我打给他。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我懂了……

lines.en: : What do you spend most of your time at home doing then?
lines.zh: : 那你在家的大部分时间都干什么?

lines.en: : Whatever I want. Drawing pictures. Swimming. Shifting all of Big Sister’s furniture that isn’t too heavy slightly to the left and watching her get confused.
lines.zh: : 想干什么干什么。画画。游泳。把姐姐家里所有搬得动的家具往左边挪一点点,然后看她一脸茫然。

lines.en: : Oh, and getting the staff to do my bidding. Can’t forget about that. I have lots of bidding that needs to be done.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有指挥仆人干活。这个不能忘。我有一大堆「吩咐」需要有人去办。

lines.en: Her story reminds me of one I’m much closer to-
lines.zh: : 她的故事让我想起另一个离我近得多的人——

lines.en: Of a girl who can barely speak about her father to me without the joy draining from her eyes as she slips into quiet reflection.
lines.zh: : 一个几乎无法向我提起她父亲的女孩。每次提起,她眼中的喜悦都会流失,滑入无声的沉思。

lines.en: And while I feel I should be worrying that something like this may one day happen to Tsukasa as well-
lines.zh: : 虽然我觉得,我该担心的是 Tsukasa 有一天会不会也落得如此——

lines.en: Instead, I find myself wondering if Ayane saw the world through such unfortunate glass.
lines.zh: : 反而,我发现自己好奇的是:Ayane 看这个世界,是不是也隔着这样不幸的玻璃。

lines.en: I’m sure that a lot of that is due to the fact that I just don’t really care about Tsukasa yet...but at least it helps me understand her.
lines.zh: : 我确信,其中一大半原因是我眼下还不在乎 Tsukasa……但至少,它帮我理解了她。

lines.en: It’s not at all unique for children to act out when they aren’t getting adequate attention from their parents after all.
lines.zh: : 孩子在得不到父母足够的关注时表现出问题行为,这本来就毫不稀奇。

lines.en: But Tsukasa is still getting attention from one of her parents.
lines.zh: : 但 Tsukasa 依然从她的父母之一那里得到关注。

lines.en: Maybe even a little too much attention if that parent is dropping what they’re doing just to come over here and pick them up despite a whole convoy of cars sent to do just that.
lines.zh: : 甚至可能多了一点——如果那位家长,在一整队轿车已经派去接她的情况下,还要放下手头的一切,亲自过来接人的话。

lines.en: It’s just not the parent she wants, I guess.
lines.zh: : 只是,那不是她想要的那个家长,我猜。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, dear...please tell me you are in there...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,亲爱的……求你告诉我你在里面……

lines.en: : About time, Mother. It’s been almost an hour and this room isn’t even climate controlled. And Jeeves is soooooo boring.
lines.zh: : 可算来了,妈妈。都快一个小时了,而且这间屋子连温控都没有。还有,Jeeves 超————无聊。

lines.en: : Jeeves? But you fired Jeeves last- oh. Oh, Tsukasa! That is so rude for someone who’s done so much for our family in just a short while!
lines.zh: : Jeeves?可你上周刚开除了——哦。哦,Tsukasa!一位这么短的时间为我们家做了这么多事的人,你这样说太无礼了!

lines.en: : All he’s done is get Big Sister to blab about him and the rest of her new friends all day long. Doesn’t that bother you?
lines.zh: : 他做的全部,就是让姐姐整天吹嘘他和她那群新朋友。这不让你烦吗?

lines.en: : Not at all, dear. Your sister is finally-
lines.zh: : 完全不会,亲爱的。你姐姐终于——

lines.en: : You know you can come in, right? You don’t have to talk through the door.
lines.zh: : 你知道你可以进来的,对吧?你不必隔着一扇门说话。

lines.en: : Oh! Silly me. I probably would have stood there all day if you hadn’t said that.
lines.zh: : 哦!瞧我。你要是不说,我大概会在门口站一整天。

lines.en: : I’m terribly sorry for any trouble my youngest daughter may have caused you. I truly didn’t expect her to refuse all of our drivers when she knew I was busy, but...Tsukasa will be Tsukasa, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我最年幼的女儿可能给你添的麻烦,我深表歉意。她知道我很忙,却拒绝了所有司机——这是我真没想到的。不过……Tsukasa 终究是 Tsukasa。

lines.en: : It’s National Tsukasa Day. I didn’t want to go home with someone being paid to care about me.
lines.zh: : 今天是全国月司日。我不想跟一个「被雇来关心我」的人回家。

lines.en: : But what about your sister? Couldn’t you have gone with her instead of burdening her teacher?
lines.zh: : 可你姐姐呢?你不能跟她走,非要麻烦她的老师?

lines.en: : Burden?
: It’s really no big deal. I’m usually here for an hour or two after class anyway. Tsukasa just sat on the couch.
lines.zh: : 真的不是什么大事。反正我下课后通常都会留一两个小时。Tsukasa 只是坐在沙发上。

lines.en: : Tsukasa should have been a good girl and left school with one of the drivers like we agreed to this morning.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 本该做个乖女孩,按我们今早的约定,跟着其中一位司机放学回家。

lines.en: : But I wanted you.
lines.zh: : 可我想要的是你。

lines.en: : And you told me we could get ice cream after I finished my first day of high school to celebrate.
lines.zh: : 而且你说过,我上完高中第一天,就带我去吃冰淇淋庆祝。

lines.en: : Darling...that was when I assumed I didn’t have to take an hour away from my meetings just to come and get you.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的……那是「我以为不必从会议里抽出一小时、亲自来接你」的前提下说的话。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if we’ll have time anymore, dear.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我们还有没有时间了,亲爱的。

lines.en: : But...Tsukasa Day...
lines.zh: : 可是……月司日……

lines.en: : Thank you again for watching over her, Sensei. I really do appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 再次感谢你照看她,Sensei。我真的感激。

lines.en: : Yeah...no worries.
lines.zh: : 嗯……别客气。

lines.en: : Come along, dear. Sensei’s time is just as valuable as ours and we have taken up enough of it.
lines.zh: : 走吧,亲爱的。Sensei 的时间和我们的一样宝贵,我们已经占用得够多了。

lines.en: : Yes, Mother...
lines.zh: : 是,妈妈……

lines.en: : Bye bye, Jeeves...
lines.zh: : 拜拜,Jeeves……

lines.en: Tsukasa exits the office and...
lines.zh: Tsukasa 走出办公室,而……

lines.en: And I somehow feel a little bad for her.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么,我居然有点为她难过。

lines.en: The feeling fades shortly after, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那种感觉很快就消散了。

lines.en: Things like that don’t normally last long for me.
lines.zh: : 这种事在我身上,通常持续不了多久。

lines.en: But the fact that it came at all tells me she’s no longer just an arrogant waste of space in my mind.
lines.zh: : 但它「出现过」这个事实告诉我:在我的心里,她已经不再只是一个傲慢的、浪费空间的摆设。

lines.en: She’s a girl, just like everyone else, trying to figure out how she best fits into this world.
lines.zh: : 她是个女孩——和所有人一样——正努力弄清自己在这个世界上的位置。

lines.en: And all things considered, that’s a lot better than just staying put and deciding you don’t belong at all.
lines.zh: : 而综合来看,这比原地不动、认定自己无处可归,要好得多。
